claim: AI-economics research, labor displacement and capability projection (Eloundou et al.) among it, measures which jobs AI eliminates, what tasks it can perform and what consumer surplus it generates
quote: AI economics research focuses primarily on labor displacement (Acemoglu and Restrepo 2019), capability projection (Eloundou et al. 2023), and welfare estimation (Brynjolfsson, Li, and Raymond 2023). claim: a distinct channel those frameworks do not measure: where human labor remains, the value tied to provenance is extracted by the system; extraction without attribution, not displacement
quote: PER identifies a distinct channel: even when human labor *remains* (the author's work is used), the economic value tied to provenance — reputation, traffic, citation credit, contractual rights — is extracted by the system. This is not displacement; it is extraction without attribution. The author's work is consumed, but the author is erased.
